diagnostic_evidence.quote: The term containing $F$ is treated in the same manner as the corresponding term in Corollary \ref{CorStrichWave}.

issues.failure_explanation: The sum defining W_n has no τ prefactor, so the F-term is the unnormalized discrete convolution Σ_{k=0}^n e^{(n-k)τA}(0,F_k). The triangle-inequality/Strichartz argument implicit in 'the same manner' gives ‖Σ_k …‖_{ℓ^p_τL^q} ≲ Σ_k ‖F_k‖_{L^2} = ‖F‖_{ℓ^1L^2}, which is τ^{-1} times the stated bound ‖F‖_{ℓ^1_τL^2} = τ Σ_k ‖F_k‖_{L^2}. A concrete counterexample: for F_k = constant c (k = 0,…,⌊T/τ⌋) and f = g = 0, the zeroth mode of w_n grows as τn²ĉ₀/2, giving ‖π_{τ⁻¹}w_n‖_{ℓ^2_τL^q} ≈ T^{5/2}|c|/τ while ‖F‖_{ℓ^1_τL^2} ≈ T|c|; the ratio diverges as τ→0.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Either add a τ prefactor to the sum in the definition of W_n (making W_n = e^{nτA}(f,g) + τ Σ_{k=0}^n e^{(n-k)τA}(0,F_k), consistent with the discrete Duhamel formula), or replace ‖F‖_{ℓ^1_{τ,T}L^2} by ‖F‖_{ℓ^1L^2} in the bound. Both repairs preserve all downstream results.
issues.overall_effect: The stated quantitative bound in CorDisStrichWave is false (too strong by a factor 1/τ). However, Lemma LemDiskrWellp and subsequent arguments use only the weaker bound ‖F‖_{ℓ^1L^2}, which is correct and sufficient; the main convergence theorems ThmStrang and ThmStrangFully remain valid.
issues.title: Discrete Strichartz corollary bound uses wrong ℓ¹ norm (off by factor 1/τ)
issues.why_classification: The correction is a single local change (insert τ or adjust one norm), requires no new lemma or argument, and all main theorems and their proofs remain intact because they use only the weaker (correct) bound.

issues.failure_explanation: At the zero Fourier mode k = 0, the symbol |k|sin(τ|k|)/(cos(τ|k|)−1) has limit −2 (via continuous extension). The resulting Ψ_{τ,0} = [[τ, −τ/2],[0, τ]] gives (e^{τA₀}−I)Ψ_{τ,0} = [[0,τ²],[0,0]], whereas τA₀Π_{τ⁻¹}|₀ = [[0,τ],[0,0]]. These differ by a factor τ in the (1,2) entry whenever τ ≠ 1. The verification step 'one checks that the equality holds' omits this mode. The downstream application in LemLokFStrangNew only needs τA²Π_{τ⁻¹}U = (e^{τA}−I)Ψ_τ AU, which does hold at k = 0 (both sides vanish there), so the proof of the local error lemma remains correct.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Redefine the Fourier multiplier of Ψ_τ at k = 0 so that (e^{τA₀}−I)Ψ_{τ,0} = τA₀ (e.g., set the symbol value at k = 0 to −2/τ, yielding Ψ_{τ,0} = [[1, −τ/2],[0, 1]]). This preserves uniform boundedness and all downstream claims.
issues.overall_effect: Lemma LemCancel is false as stated (the operator identity fails at the single Fourier mode k = 0). Its use in Lemma LemLokFStrangNew is nonetheless valid because the zero mode of AU has the form (v̂₀, 0) and is annihilated by both sides. All main convergence theorems are unaffected.
issues.title: Summation-by-parts operator identity fails at the zero Fourier mode
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local redefinition of one Fourier mode of Ψ_τ (or restricting the identity to k ≠ 0). It requires no new argument and every substantive claim and guarantee survives unchanged.
